title: Tom Brown's death
summary: Mares says Brown died suddenly of pneumonia after a session, having played with one lung.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Yeah, he doesn't seem really old to me. he's been
around for ages, but he died so suddenly I didn't even know it. He'd been sick. He wasn't sick when he, what was it, pneumonia that he took? Well, he took pneumonia, but he had

a collapsed lung. In fact, the last tune I made on a session, I had to cut his solo out because he couldn't make it. Was that something in recent years or later? I don't know. I didn't know it, but I understand he played with one lung. Actually, he looked so small
he didn't look so healthy, but yet those small people like that sometimes. That's right.
He could go. He went on and went on. I like Tom. Tom was good people. He didn't have a
cold or pneumonia. No, but he went into pneumonia. Right after that. That was it. Are there any more of those sessions that you want to go through? Any other things about?
